title: Concept: Workspace-wide dependency version is left open
description: Cargo.toml declares a workspace dependency that declares no version, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a workspace dependency that declares no version.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through Cargo.toml (cargo).
risk: The declaration leaves version choice to a resolver run, so a release published after this review is taken without a new decision. This rule reads a workspace dependency that declares no version.
